items.text: Jets have ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) for Sunday’s game vs. the Browns.
items.why: Quad injury; consecutive DNPs and ruled out Friday.
items.implication: Braelon Allen full workload again as lead back.

items.text: Eagles say DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday; Barkley week-to-week, not expected for London vs JAX.
items.why: Hamstring; consecutive DNPs, Rapoport confirms week-to-week not long-term.
items.implication: Will Shipley leads backfield; Dameon Pierce signed.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle; Friday’s practice looms large for Sunday night availability in Atlanta.
items.why: Ankle injury; Rapoport notes only outside chance.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley likely if out; Ravens offense downgrade.

items.text: Hate to say negative things about great players like Malik Nabers. Fear ways it can go sideways later: knee becomes real issue, can't shake shoulder, JJ McCarthy under center, coaching boomer it up. (After DNP for sore knee).
items.why: Sore knee DNP + prior frustration on targets; multi-risk factors.

items.text: Cowboys WR CeeDee Lamb dealing with quad bruise from TNF; extra few days should help.
items.why: Quad bruise sustained Thursday night; full practice prior noted in reports.
items.implication: Should be fine for Week 5 with rest.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; potential limited role or sit.

items.text: No practice again Thursday for Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot).
I have Allen ranked just above Wilson this week, if Breece is out.
items.why: Hall OUT confirmed elevates Allen; Wilson still strong.

items.text: “I think it’s gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville” after Barkley/Bigsby injuries; Eagles lose both in Week 4.
items.why: Barkley hamstring OUT expected, Bigsby IR; Shipley primary.
items.implication: Volume spike for Shipley in London.

items.text: Love, love, LOVE Nico Collins against the Titans this week. I have Nico as my WR8.
Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5 love; tied to Bengals injuries and soft run D.
items.why: Workload + Dolphins defense carved by RBs; Bengals WR injuries boost.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41) and Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17); tough matchups, thin roles, usage numbers.
items.why: Matchups, roles, stats; Addison injury wrinkle.

items.text: First run of projections for Week 5 live. DET-ARZ shaping up as one of the most popular DFS game stacks due to slate context (total 54.5, no other over 45.5) and pricing.
Bijan Robinson, Kyren Williams performing well above expected on opportunities so far. Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming on theirs.
items.why: xFP vs actual data through 4 weeks.
items.implication: Sustain or regress for over/under performers; Bijan/Kyren positive.
